name: shared-energy-cap
accounting_rule: sum over control steps of dt_s * (abs(port_policy_thrust_n) + abs(starboard_policy_thrust_n))

force_separation_precheck.bcod-sim: policy actuator thrust remains separate in vehicle_diagnostics.effectors; environmental force is applied by the plant
force_separation_precheck.gazebo: actuator-jsonl bridge returns applied_thrust_newtons before any environmental plugin force
force_separation_precheck.holoocean: _thruster_state_n is retained separately before wind_surge_force_n is added for the engine call
force_separation_precheck.stonefish: native diagnostics report port_thrust and starboard_thrust independently of environmental force
